walkthroughs.body_html:
Software — a core area of GCSE Computer Science.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Software brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Software.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

mcqs.q: Which of these is the best definition of “Utility software”?
options: Software whose source code is freely available to view, modify and distribute.
Low-level software embedded in hardware, e.g., the BIOS or device controllers.
System tools such as antivirus, disk defragmenter, file compression and backup.
Software whose source code is owned and kept private by its publisher.
